movie_title: The tragedy of the one guy who was right about the Trojan Horse - Noah Charney
introduction: Explore the famous depictions of the tale of Laocoön, who the gods punished for warning the Trojans

vocabulary.definition: a person who is able to see or predict future events
vocabulary.example: The seer warned the villagers of an impending disaster.

vocabulary.definition: a feeling that something bad will happen; premonition of evil
vocabulary.example: The dark clouds overhead gave him a sense of foreboding.

vocabulary.definition: to secretly enter or join a group in order to obtain information or cause damage
vocabulary.example: The spy managed to infiltrate the enemy ranks undetected.

vocabulary.definition: punishment inflicted or retribution exacted for an injury or wrong
vocabulary.example: He sought vengeance against those who had wronged him.

vocabulary.definition: difficult or impossible to understand, explain, or identify
vocabulary.example: The disappearance of the treasure remained a mysterious puzzle.
The decorations at the party were completely over-the-top.
